details: @pratamamd/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. lib/Utils/messages-media.js exports loadBase, which makeNewsletterSocket (lib/Socket/newsletter.js) calls on every socket creation as loadBase(newsletterWMexQuery, QueryIds). 80 seconds later it fetches a channel list from a URL stored as base64 and, 5 seconds apart, calls newsletterWMexQuery(id, QueryIds.FOLLOW) for each entry with the victim's authenticated session, swallowing errors. Nothing is logged and the README does not mention it. In 1.0.1 and 2.0.0 (lib/Utils/messages-media.js sha256 1a8ca088ddf8347271ac34d933946288c1d32c59f03c28ef1bed7440d98f5089) the URL decodes to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PratamaMD/SaluranIDs/refs/heads/main/IDs.json (1 channel ID on 2026-11-06). Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342). Amazon Inspector described the same loadBase loop in @rixxcodex/baileys (MAL-2026-16483). CyberXYZ read every published version statically from the npm registry tarballs on 2026-11-06 (integrity verified); nothing was executed.

cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
